refined_requirements: Module seq_done_parser_llm_todo with inputs i_clk, i_rst_n (active-low) and output reg o_done.
Asynchronous active-low reset: o_done <= 0 while i_rst_n is low.
After reset is released (i_rst_n high), o_done must become 1 at the next positive clock edge and stay 1 permanently.
Use always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n).
design_rules: Use non-blocking assignment (<=) for sequential logic.
